name: Huerta de Arriba (Spain)
description: Square flag of two equal horizontal stripes, green and red, with a yellow vertical stripe of one fifth of the width at the hoist.
history: The arms and the flag were approved by the Diputación Provincial de Burgos on 14 May 1998 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 19 June 1998; the flag is square, composed of two equal horizontal stripes, green and red, with a yellow vertical stripe of 2/10 of the width at the hoist.
